name: Intl and locale formatting quirks
plain: Reads Intl resolved options and formatting outputs for many locales and calendars.
meaning: Beyond timezone and language, ICU data version, supported calendars and numbering systems differ per browser build and OS, enabling version and cloak detection.

steps: Format a fixed date in a dozen locales

limits.headline: Can check language, calendar and number format settings to spot your browser build
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads
can: Test how your browser formats dates, numbers and money in many languages
Learn which calendars and numbering systems it supports
Learn your browser build and system from the differences
Spot tools that fake your language or time zone
cannot: See what you typed or saved
Know who you are by itself
Tell your exact location, only your language and time zone settings

story.what_it_is: A script reads how your browser formats dates, numbers and languages to learn your locale and engine details.

marketing.name: Intl
marketing.pitch: Built in tools that format dates, numbers and text correctly for each language and region.

story.for_you: You never see it. Sites use it to show prices, dates and numbers the way you expect, like 1,000.50 or 1.000,50. A quieter side effect is that the output reveals your region, calendar and browser.
story.for_makers: Shops and apps need it to show correct local formats. Fraud tools compare your formats with your IP location, and trackers add them to a device ID.

use_cases.example: A store shows prices in your currency with the right commas and symbols.
A booking site shows dates in your local order, day then month or month then day.
A bank notices a login claiming a Japanese locale from an IP in another country and asks extra questions.
A fingerprint library records the time zone and calendar your browser reports.
An ad network targets by language and region read from locale settings.
A browser game with a leaderboard shows scores and dates in your local format.
A news site picks the right language edition from locale data.

technical_bounds: Timezone also available via Date, so not an extra bit alone

value.abuse: Locale and ICU version pinning, VPN versus timezone mismatch
